title_en: Apple Arcade Is Offering a One-Month Free Trial to Subscribers Plus Access to New Launches Like NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition and Football Manager 27 Touch
summary_en: Those who subscribe to Apple Arcade can enjoy a one-month free trial plus access to new launches, including Football Manager 27 Touch, NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition, and Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition.
body_en:
If you've been thinking about signing up for Apple Arcade, now is a great time to do it. The mobile gaming service is offering a one-month free trial to subscribers , which is a fantastic way to test it out, but it also sets you up with access to new launches like Football Manager 27 Touch , NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition , and Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition .
After that month-long trial has run its course, Apple Arcade's $6.99/month cost will kick in. We certainly think it's worth sticking with – as it's our favorite mobile gaming subscription – but even if you're just interested in testing out the trial period right now, you'll still have access to a huge library of games to play. This includes the previously mentioned sports titles, which are some recent highlights.
Madden NFL 27 Arcade Edition released just a few months ago in August, while NBA 2K27 Arcade Edition and Football Manager 27 Touch were both November launches. It's worth keeping in mind that these games are only available to subscribers, so if you've been itching to boot one of them up on your phone, this free trial offer is a great way to see what they're like without spending a penny.
Alongside having a solid library of games to play, Apple Arcade also stands out for having no annoying ads or in-app purchases to deal with. Plus, you can use it across all of your Apple devices, from iPhone to iPad and even Apple TV. And if you're not a fan of playing games just on a touchscreen, don't worry, we've got a selection of great phone controllers for mobile gaming that you can check out.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the commerce team here at IGN.
